steps_h2: How to Make Carousel Video Ad Videos in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Use one product photo to build an ordered story, then add exact listing details after download.

steps.d: Add one clear source photo and keep the full product or garment visible. Use the item that appears on your destination page.
Choose one action and describe the setting or comparison shoppers should see. Keep each beat focused so the story moves from opening to next step.
Download the result and add exact offer or listing details in your editor. Post the clip where shoppers already browse.

faq.a: Use one sharp photo with the full product visible and enough detail to show its shape, finish and useful features.

faq.q: What result does this template show?
faq.a: It creates one ordered carousel video ad that moves from an opening view to a product action and a clear finish.

faq.q: Which length or format should I choose?
faq.a: Use 6 seconds for a short reveal, 10 or 15 seconds for a few product beats, or 30 seconds when the story needs more explanation. Choose 1:1 for a square feed or 9:16 for a vertical format.

faq.q: Can I change details after download?
faq.a: Yes. Add or update the headline, price, dimensions and call to action as editable text after download.

faq.q: Do I need a shoot day?
faq.a: No. Start with the product photo you already have and choose the story beats instead of booking a creator, location or gear.

faq.q: Where can I use the clip?
faq.a: Use the downloaded clip in your own paid ads, product pages and posts where the chosen format fits. Downloads carry no AIVideosUGC watermark.

visual.overview: A carousel template turns one product photo into an ordered story so shoppers can follow the product from first look to use.

steps.sourceHint: Show the whole backpack and its main compartments.
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. At a cafe table, an adult opens the black commuter backpack and places a notebook into its front organizer pocket. End with the pocket open and the full bag visible. Eye-level close framing with a gentle push-in. Warm cafe-window light. Sound: zipper and quiet cafe room tone, no music.
